Title: Source 3
Content: :ibox:The photograph, from the `text(1920s)`, shows a billboard advertisement for an automatic electric washer. On the left side of the advertisement, a woman is shown hanging clothes on a clothesline, and on the right side is a picture of a washing machine. The text on the advertisement is “Ask for a Home Demonstration. Automatic Electric Washer. ‘Cleans Clothes Clean.’ `$5.00` Down, `$5.00` a `text(Month)`. Carolina Power & Light Company.”
